name: Case law: United States, the special federal courts (Claims, Customs, Customs and Patent Appeals, Tax, International Trade, military and others)
label: United States case law (the special federal courts (Claims, Customs, Customs and Patent Appeals, Tax, International Trade, military and others))
coverage: 143963 published decisions, one file each, dated the day decided: 145033 with their opinion text and 126 with CAP head matter only (CAP holds no opinion text for them); 5963 citations of the US Code linked to united-states/federal/usc.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day decided. Commits before 1970 are dated 1970-01-01, a second apart; In-force holds the real day. Read from Cust. Ct., Ct. Cl., M.J., T.C., B.T.A., F.2d, C.C.P.A., Fed. Cl., F. Supp., Ct. Int'l Trade, C.M.A., F. Supp. 2d and 25 more. The head matter (syllabi, headnotes, counsel) is left out: it is the publisher's text, not the court's. Every decision is a published opinion (precedential_status: published); CAP records no other status. CAP is a closed archive (its last volumes are of 2018-2020): no nightly runner appends to this repo. The US Code record holds only some titles, so most statute citations are not linked.
update: none: the Caselaw Access Project is a static archive, so no nightly runner is registered

source.publisher: Caselaw Access Project (Harvard Law School Library)
source.reporters: Cust. Ct., Ct. Cl., M.J., T.C., B.T.A., F.2d, C.C.P.A., Fed. Cl., F. Supp., Ct. Int'l Trade, C.M.A., F. Supp. 2d and 25 more

overlay.reader: tools/usc_cite.py: a page stamp ("USCA4") is no citation, "(a)(4)" a subsection, "§§ 1-16" a range read at its two ends; a citation under an older numbering (before the title was recodified, before the section was added, an earlier edition, "former") is not linked; one row per decision (decision-relations.tsv duplicates left out)

relations.same-decision-as: the file is the same decision as the target (same day, docket or name, and text); both are kept
relations.moved-to: the decision was routed here by mistake and is now at the target (<repo>/<path>); this file was removed

decision_dates.note: decisions whose CAP date gives only the month or the year (precision month or year): committed on the first day of it, In-force likewise
